checks: The simplex inequalities and zero-sum normals give −d≤L_B≤U_B≤1. Thus h+U_B≥ℓ_B+(H−m), where H−m>0, and integration keeps the full b contribution.
The fixed-direction sharp projection predecessor gives Pη^(d−1); P=Vdσ/m≥Vd/m. From b/V=dη^(d−1)−(d−1)η^d≤dη^(d−1), the stated weaker estimate Hb/m follows with the correct sign.

The entire segment sits over one transverse coordinate, so interval addition gives [l+L_B,h+U_B]. The lower endpoint is strictly negative and the upper strictly positive in every nonempty B column. Its clipped length is exactly h+U_B, and the transverse translation preserves ν.

The final set inclusion uses only S⊆A and (A+B)/2⊆K; dilation preserves the test halfspace and contributes 2^d. Source 588e75e8ff86db2e §4 uses the same h, l and t normalization and states a lower bound, without sharp roof optimality.
